tours.name: Half a Day in a Leave Allocation

name_i18n.en_US: Half a Day in a Leave Allocation

tours.description: Learn how to give half a day or other fractions of a day in an allocation, without saving anything.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to give half a day or other fractions of a day in an allocation, without saving anything.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Allocations are managed in the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: Allocations are managed in the Time Off app.

steps.title: Management menu
steps.description: The Management menu holds the requests and allocations of all employees.

description_i18n.en_US: The Management menu holds the requests and allocations of all employees.

steps.title: Allocations
steps.description: Each line gives an employee, department or company a number of leave days.

description_i18n.en_US: Each line gives an employee, department or company a number of leave days.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create an allocation.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create an allocation.

steps.description: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

steps.title: Type half a day
steps.description: Allocations accept fractions of a day. Half a day gives an employee one half-day request. Use a point as the decimal separator.

description_i18n.en_US: Allocations accept fractions of a day. Half a day gives an employee one half-day request. Use a point as the decimal separator.

steps.title: Check the days
steps.content: Look at the duration. Click the field to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the duration. Click the field to continue.

steps.description: The duration keeps the decimals. A value of zero is accepted too, but gives the employee nothing.

description_i18n.en_US: The duration keeps the decimals. A value of zero is accepted too, but gives the employee nothing.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.
